name: Pizzeria Primavera
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Primavera in Going am Wilden Kaiser**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Primavera** in **Going am Wilden Kaiser**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy spot offers delicious wood-fired pizzas, fresh pasta, and a selection of fine wines—all in a warm, rustic setting. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Diavola**, every bite is made with care. Don’t miss their homemade desserts, like creamy **Tiramisu** or rich **Cannoli**. Perfect for a relaxed meal after exploring the stunning **Kaisergebirge** or a quick stop before heading to **Ellmau** or **Scheffau**. Come for the food, stay for the atmosphere!
